description: Directives in the shapes that test each output's wrapper: hooks that read module constants named like the wrappers' own names, an `updated` with a local named `oldValue`, a hook that returns a value and one with a parameter it never reads, values conditionals narrow, two of them reassigned by a handler, two directives beside a `v-model` on one element, and an imported directive whose element type is an alias.
requires: Every render of the case holds what the directives' `mounted` writes, which a static target never runs: the server render checks the static targets, without it.
